name: ReaSet
sub_title: Live setlist, transport, lyrics and chords for REAPER
description: Installs ReaSet into REAPER, including its unified background script and web interface. Optional tools and recommended extensions can be selected below.

tools.name: ReaSet authoring and diagnostic tools
tools.description: Installs Lyrics Tapper, ReaSet Diagnose, Library Doctor and Text to MIDI Bitmap, plus the ReaImGui extension required by Lyrics Tapper.

sws.name: SWS/S&M Extension (recommended)
sws.description: Recommended for reading Item Notes used by ReaSet lyrics and chords. ReaSet transport remains usable without it.
